// diagnostic

E0639

`{name}` takes `self`, but it is not a method

What

`{name}` takes `self`, but it is not a method

Why

`self` is the value a method is called on; a function outside a type body or `impl` has no such value, so `self` would silently be an ordinary parameter

Fix

Move `{name}` into the type's body or an `impl` block to make it a method, or give the parameter another name

Worked example

 Fix: Move `show` into the type's body or an `impl` block to make it a method, or give the parameter another name
